principle: Rechercher Ω remains the single canonical AI orchestration layer; this module supplies provider interoperability and optional operational adapters only.

posthog.license: MIT outside ee; ee has separate Enterprise license

agent_workers.role: optional isolated agent workers behind Rechercher Ω
agent_workers.policy: Agents may inspect, research, test and propose changes; all repository changes must flow through isolated branches/PR review and deterministic gates; no direct canonical Corpus writes.

grounded_retrieval.policy: Every retrieval result carries source/work/edition/language/provenance/rights identifiers; generated text never becomes evidence.

manuscript_intelligence.role: OCR/HTR and manuscript processing research adapters
manuscript_intelligence.policy: Derived OCR must remain non-canonical until multi-engine comparison, checksum/provenance and QC gates pass.

knowledge_graph.policy: Graphs encode documented relationships and provenance; they do not create religious authority or infer rulings.
